final_resume.summary: Software Development Engineer with 3+ years of professional experience designing and building distributed systems, scalable backends, and APIs using Java and Spring Boot. Demonstrated expertise in algorithms, design patterns, and code review practices across the full software development lifecycle. Seeking to deepen ownership in high-scale transactional systems and operational excellence.

bullets: Architected Spring Boot microservices for shipment tracking using design patterns, processing 2 million events daily from Kafka with high reliability and scalability.
Designed and implemented contract tests between the tracking API and React console, catching 9 breaking changes before production release through rigorous code review.
Deployed 5 containerised services to Kubernetes on AWS, establishing operational excellence and reducing deployment friction.
Developed React and TypeScript frontend for dispatcher console serving 300 concurrent operators with responsive, algorithm-optimised state management.
Automated 80 checkout regression tests using Selenium and Java, establishing coding standards and source control discipline.
Executed JMeter load tests for high-traffic festive-sale release, validating system reliability under scale.

projects.name: A11y Audit Helper
projects.description: Built a React and TypeScript browser extension that flags accessibility violations (missing alt text, low-contrast elements) on web pages, demonstrating algorithm-driven pattern detection.

profile_improvement_tips: Explicitly mention API design or REST API development in a future role to directly address the JD's emphasis on scalable APIs.
Quantify the scale of the distributed system further (e.g., latency targets, throughput SLAs) to reinforce operational excellence.
Add a bullet highlighting your participation in architectural design reviews or system reliability improvements to strengthen the 2+ years of design/architecture requirement.
